test_title: PYST 75: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 29 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
P is the mother of Q. Q is the sister of R. R is the brother of S. S is the husband of T. T is the sister of U. U is the wife of V.

How many female members are in family?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) P is the mother of Q.

2) Q is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7ea6f6c7ba53211b5e410d9899c5bd33b0d5607b31fcf776d5a164942599798.png] 

3) R is the brother of S.

4) S is the husband of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/733e42e68319709e0b6ca950c2752fc6446ed31e5f67cdcc4f34613bf6c73ca1.png] 

5) T is the sister of U.

6) U is the wife of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8aad479a5b4a2ce96b41e91b346251db2a1eab59f5bf62599f57be455899833.png] 

Thus, there are a total of four female members.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
